method: upstream card license/license_name and declared base_model via the HF API; weight lineage (tools/weight_lineage.py) where the base is undeclared or ambiguous

mismatches.evidence: the re-host's own base_model; upstream license_name qwen-research

decoder config equals Qwen1.5-0.5B (hidden 1024, FFN 2816, 24 layers, 16 heads / 16 KV heads, rope 1e6) and differs from Qwen2-0.5B (896/4864, 14/2 heads); weight cosine to Qwen1.5-0.5B 0.855 (layer 0), 0.612 (12), 0.426 (23); GOT paper (arXiv:2409.01704 sec. 3.3.1) 'we adopt the Qwen [4] with 500M parameters as the decoder', citing the 2023 Qwen technical report; the first 0.5B Qwen was Qwen1.5-0.5B
mismatches.note: Tongyi Qianwen RESEARCH LICENSE: non-commercial and 'can not use the Materials or any output therefrom to improve any other large language model'; registry description says Qwen2-0.5B, which is wrong

soft_obligations.note: InternLM weights: academic use open, free commercial use after submitting InternLM's application form; InternVL2.5's card calls the component Apache-2.0

consistent.german-ocr-3.1: Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct (apache-2.0) per its GGUF metadata (general.architecture qwen2vl, base_model Qwen/Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct, projector qwen2vl_merger). Both keyvan-ai/ and Keyven/german-ocr-3.1 ship the same files; their card's 'Aufgebaut auf Qwen3.5' does not match the files (a Qwen3.5 model cannot be a qwen2vl GGUF). Either base is apache-2.0, so the license conclusion is unchanged; the registry description (Qwen2-VL-2B) matches the files.
consistent.qwen3-embed-*, octen-*, f2llm-*, harrier: Qwen3 (apache-2.0) or own restrictive label already

license_terms.qwen-research: non-commercial only; redistribute with agreement + NOTICE line; 'Built with Qwen' when used to build distributed models; no anti-competition clause
license_terms.qwen: commercial allowed below 100M monthly active users; same attribution
license_terms.tongyi-qianwen / tongyi-qianwen-research: older Qwen1/1.5 terms; prohibit using the materials or their outputs to improve any other LLM; the research variant is also non-commercial
